threads.body:
This update only changes the version comment; the pinned commit `95ef2b042f9d7a56d8268cba8559e2842e2ad01b` is identical to the pre-PR value. The workflow will therefore continue executing the old `ruby/setup-ruby` revision rather than v1.321.0. Replace the digest with the commit for v1.321.0 (while retaining the SHA pin).

This issue also appears on line 411 of the same file.
threads.hunk:
@@ -95,9 +95,9 @@ jobs:
           npm --prefix scenarios/http/js test
 
       - name: Set up Ruby
-        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@95ef2b042f9d7a56d8268cba8559e2842e2ad01b # v1
+        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@95ef2b042f9d7a56d8268cba8559e2842e2ad01b # v1.321.0
